mapper.select: SELECT VALUE_TABLE.ORDER_NO, VALUE_TABLE.PRODUCT_NO, VALUE_TABLE.OPTION_NAME, DATE_FORMAT(VALUE_TABLE.EXACT_DATE_VAL, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS EXACT_DATE_VAL FROM( SELECT ORDER_NO, PRODUCT_NO, OPTION_NAME, IFNULL(SETTLEMENT_DATE,IFNULL(CONFIRM_DATE,AUTO_CONFIRM_DATE)) AS EXACT_DATE_VAL, EXACT_SETTLE_DATE FROM CBCI_INTERPARK_SALES WHERE ORDER_STATUS IN ('배송완료','구매확정')) AS VALUE_TABLE WHERE IF(VALUE_TABLE.EXACT_SETTLE_DATE IS NULL , VALUE_TABLE.EXACT_SETTLE_DATE IS NULL, DATE_FORMAT(VALUE_TABLE.EXACT_SETTLE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') != DATE_FORMAT(VALUE_TABLE.EXACT_DATE_VAL, '%Y-%m-%d'))

SELECT VALUE_TABLE.ORDER_NO, VALUE_TABLE.PRODUCT_NO, DATE_FORMAT(VALUE_TABLE.EXACT_DATE_VAL, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS EXACT_DATE_VAL FROM( SELECT ORDER_NO, PRODUCT_NO, IFNULL(SETTLEMENT_DATE, IFNULL(IF(CONFIRM_DATE='', NULL , CONFIRM_DATE),DATE_ADD(DELIVERED_DATE, INTERVAL 8 DAY))) AS EXACT_DATE_VAL, EXACT_SETTLE_DATE FROM CBCI_GMARKET_SALES WHERE DELIVERY_STATUS IN ('배송완료')) AS VALUE_TABLE WHERE IF(VALUE_TABLE.EXACT_SETTLE_DATE IS NULL , VALUE_TABLE.EXACT_SETTLE_DATE IS NULL, DATE_FORMAT(VALUE_TABLE.EXACT_SETTLE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') != DATE_FORMAT(VALUE_TABLE.EXACT_DATE_VAL, '%Y-%m-%d'));

SELECT VALUE_TABLE.ORDER_NO, VALUE_TABLE.PRODUCT_NO, DATE_FORMAT(VALUE_TABLE.EXACT_DATE_VAL, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS EXACT_DATE_VAL FROM( SELECT ORDER_NO, PRODUCT_NO, IFNULL(SETTLEMENT_DATE, IFNULL(IF(CONFIRM_DATE='', NULL , CONFIRM_DATE),DATE_ADD(DELIVERED_DATE, INTERVAL 8 DAY))) AS EXACT_DATE_VAL, EXACT_SETTLE_DATE FROM CBCI_AUCTION_SALES WHERE DELIVERY_STATUS IN ('배송완료')) AS VALUE_TABLE WHERE IF(VALUE_TABLE.EXACT_SETTLE_DATE IS NULL , VALUE_TABLE.EXACT_SETTLE_DATE IS NULL, DATE_FORMAT(VALUE_TABLE.EXACT_SETTLE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') != DATE_FORMAT(VALUE_TABLE.EXACT_DATE_VAL, '%Y-%m-%d'))

SELECT VALUE_TABLE.주문번호 AS ORDER_NO, VALUE_TABLE.주문순번 AS ORDER_TURN, VALUE_TABLE.선결제배송비 AS PAYDEL_AMOUNT, VALUE_TABLE.반품보험료 AS RETURN_INSUR, DATE_FORMAT(VALUE_TABLE.EXACT_DATE_VAL, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS EXACT_DATE_VAL FROM( SELECT 주문번호, 주문순번, 선결제배송비, 반품보험료, IF(송금완료일 = '', IF(수취확인일 = '', IF(TRIM(송장번호) = '', DATE_ADD(발송처리일, INTERVAL 29 DAY), DATE_ADD(배송완료일, INTERVAL 8 DAY)) , DATE_FORMAT(수취확인일, '%Y-%m-%d')) , DATE_FORMAT(송금완료일, '%Y-%m-%d')) AS EXACT_DATE_VAL, EXACT_SETTLE_DATE FROM CBCI_11ST_SALEACCNT WHERE 주문상태 IN ('배송완료', '구매확정')) AS VALUE_TABLE WHERE IF(VALUE_TABLE.EXACT_SETTLE_DATE IS NULL , VALUE_TABLE.EXACT_SETTLE_DATE IS NULL, DATE_FORMAT(VALUE_TABLE.EXACT_SETTLE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') != DATE_FORMAT(VALUE_TABLE.EXACT_DATE_VAL, '%Y-%m-%d'))

SELECT VALUE_TABLE.ORDER_NO, VALUE_TABLE.PRODUCT_ORDER_NO, VALUE_TABLE.COLLECT_YN, DATE_FORMAT(VALUE_TABLE.EXACT_DATE_VAL, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS EXACT_DATE_VAL FROM( SELECT ORDER_NO, PRODUCT_ORDER_NO, COLLECT_YN, IFNULL(SETTLEMENT_DATE, IF(CONFIRM_DATE = '', IF(AUTO_CONFIRM_DATE = '', IF(DELIVERED_DATE = '', DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(SHIPMENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 20 DAY),DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(DELIVERED_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 8 DAY)) , AUTO_CONFIRM_DATE) , CONFIRM_DATE)) AS EXACT_DATE_VAL, EXACT_SETTLE_DATE FROM CBCI_NAVER_SALES WHERE ORDER_STATUS IN ('일반정산','빠른정산','배송완료','구매확정','정산후 취소','교환','빠른정산 회수')) AS VALUE_TABLE WHERE IF(VALUE_TABLE.EXACT_SETTLE_DATE IS NULL , VALUE_TABLE.EXACT_SETTLE_DATE IS NULL, DATE_FORMAT(VALUE_TABLE.EXACT_SETTLE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') != DATE_FORMAT(VALUE_TABLE.EXACT_DATE_VAL, '%Y-%m-%d'))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CBCI_SCHEDULED_REPORT( SCHEDULED_NAME, SHOP_TYPE, SHOP_NM, SHOP_ID, CAUSE, RUNTIME, INPUT_DATE ) VALUES ( #{SCHEDULED_NAME}, #{SHOP_TYPE}, #{SHOP_NM}, 'SERVER', #{CAUSE}, #{RUNTIME}, DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') )

INSERT INTO CBCI_ERR_REPORT( SHOP_ID, CODE_ID, CODE_NM, CAUSE, RUNTIME, ERROR_LOG, INPUT_DATETIME ) VALUES ( 'SERVER', #{SHOP_TYPE}, #{SHOP_NM}, #{SCHEDULED_NAME}, #{RUNTIME}, #{CAUSE}, DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') )
